prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions overall tended to overestimate positive impact (especially in rounds 1, 2, and 5), but underestimated gains in winning tests during rounds 3, 4, and 6.
home wait_info changes can be helpful, backed by 3 winning tests (rounds 3, 4, and 7), though 3 tests showed no clear effect (rounds 1, 5, and 8).
sign_in hint changes can be helpful, backed by 2 winning tests (rounds 4 and 6), though 5 tests showed no clear effect (rounds 1, 2, 5, 7, and 8).
choose_path layout changes showed no clear effect across 2 agreeing tests (rounds 1 and 5).
home notification changes showed no clear effect across 2 agreeing tests (rounds 2 and 6).
Evidence remains thin for adoption redesign, finish new_flow, finish new_screen, and choose_path redesign due to disagreeing outcomes, as well as for all kinds of change with only a single test.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -6.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Tray & Shortcut Setup Screen: Adds a dedicated onboarding screen at the finish step showing hotkeys, tray icon controls, and desktop pet visibility toggles. (why: 3 support tickets highlighted post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the desktop pet.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Deferred Account Sign-In Flow: Move sign-in after pet adoption choices so users customize their pet before signing in to save it. (why: Signing in early (80.1% conversion) before creating a pet reduces motivation. Moving auth later leverages commitment consistency.)
2: [home, new_flow] Desktop Pet Spawn Calibration Flow: Introduce a calibration step during render waiting that lets users test pet placement and screen overlay settings. (why: Home wait time averages 2336s and 3 users reported pets failing to appear on desktop or app failing to launch properly.)
3: [choose_path, copy] Path Commitment Time Expectation Headline: Clarify total expected onboarding time and pet setup steps in the story welcome screen header. (why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s despite 8s median, showing long tail hesitation when choosing a path.)
4: [home, wait_info] Interactive Desktop Pet Idle Activity Stream: Display a tip carousel of pet animations and idle behavior previews on the waiting screen while rendering. (why: Waiting stage median is 201s and mean is 2336s. Wait info enhancements consistently won in rounds 3, 4, and 7.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Cloud Account Sync Safeguard Hint: Display a explicit data preservation hint explaining account sign-in prevents pet loss on reinstallation. (why: 8 support emails (the top issue category) complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
6: [adoption, incentive] Pet Adoption Certificate Milestone Badge: Add an interactive celebratory mascot and completion badge component to the adoption certificate screen. (why: Adoption completion rate drops to 66.2%. Rewarding users at certificate creation boosts motivation to finish.)
7: [finish, notification] Desktop Launch Status Completion Notification: Enable desktop completion notification prompt on home_intro when pet setup finishes in background. (why: Finish screen mean time is high (5815s), suggesting users switch windows and miss completion.)

scores.note: Adding a new screen at finish has historically decreased conversion (-2.9% average across 3 tests).
Reordering sign_in step previously resulted in a significant drop (-7.0%).
New flows carry high friction and cost, with poor performance historical trends.
Low cost copy tweak targeting heavy drop-off/hesitation, previous test showed positive lift.
Home wait_info changes are well-proven with 3 winning tests and consistent positive average lift.
Strongest evidence combination: top support complaint (8 emails) and proven sign_in hint track record.
Targets the worst funnel step (adoption 66.2%), though component redesigns have mixed past results.
Addresses huge mean delay (5815s) at finish, but notification changes show modest overall impact.
